scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: besides dandruff units (whose itch/tension words are absorbed, E2a/SC1), the manufacturer sentence 'Deine juckende Kopfhaut wird beruhigt und das Spannungsgefühl reduziert.' is its own claim unit that does not name Schuppen -> explicit sensitive (itch, 'beruhigt') and dry ('Spannungsgefühl') positioning, moderate. Supportive architecture: two-buffer moderate chassis, prominent Panthenol (12), Glycerin (14), Glyceryl Oleate refatter (7), mallow; no menthol. Counter-signal: fragrance; the sentence is contextually a dandruff-symptom statement.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Piroctone Olamine (6). Zinc PCA is not a recognized active under §11.
